references.text: Jesus answers Peter's desire for a complete washing by explaining that the one who has been bathed (fully cleansed) only needs to wash his feet, confirming that Peter is already clean except for his feet.
The direct dialogue in verses 6-8 shows Peter's resistance to being washed, which ends with his specific request to have not only his feet but also his hands and head washed.
After washing the feet, Jesus explains that he has given an example of service, contextualizing Peter's initial resistance and his later desire for a complete washing.
